players.name: Cade Cunningham
players.comment: Cunningham (knee) is expected to play in Friday's game against the Raptors, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

players.name: Duncan Robinson
players.comment: Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.

players.name: RJ Barrett
players.comment: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Collin Murray-Boyles
players.comment: Murray-Boyles (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pistons.
